# Banned phrases

Never output these (or close variants). They carry no information and make every CV look the same.

## English
- passionate, highly motivated, results-driven, detail-oriented, team player, self-starter
- dynamic, proactive, go-getter, hard-working, synergy, leverage(d) synergies
- responsible for, in charge of, tasked with, worked on, helped with, participated in
- various, several different, a number of, etc.
- cutting-edge, state-of-the-art, best-in-class, world-class, innovative solution
- successfully (as filler: "successfully delivered")
- co-built, co-developed, co-designed, co-created, jointly, together with, with the team, as part of a team
- team-benefit framing: the team's shared foundation, for the rest of the team, used by the whole team
- "the team" or "we" as the subject of a sentence ("the team adopted…", "we chose…")

## French
- passionné, motivé, dynamique, rigoureux, force de proposition, esprit d'équipe
- polyvalent, proactif, autonome (as a claim without proof)
- en charge de, chargé de, responsable de, participation à, travail sur
- divers, différents (as filler: "différents types de"), etc.
- solution innovante, à la pointe, de bout en bout (as filler)
- avec succès
- co-construit, co-développé, co-conçu, co-réalisé, conjointement, en équipe, avec l'équipe
- cadrage au bénéfice de l'équipe : socle commun de l'équipe, pour le reste de l'équipe, utilisé par toute l'équipe
- « l'équipe » ou « nous » comme sujet d'une phrase (« l'équipe a adopté… », « nous avons choisi… »)

## Structural bans
- Starting the description with a stack of nouns: "Définition, développement et amélioration de…"
- Chained nominalizations: "Amélioration de la gestion de la création des…"
- Tool lists inside sentences when they are already in **Solutions**
- Team-centered framing: a lead sentence or bullet whose subject is the team rather than the person's contribution
